messages:
tara: quick check-in on provenance plan - two options: inline expanded headers vs tiny header + envelope store. short pros/cons below.

min: TL;DR which keeps tail latency low?

tara: tiny header + envelope wins for steady-state latency. headers stay small (cost_key only), envelope used for billing/recon. inline headers simpler for ops but inflate metrics and can hit header limits.

gil: envelope means we must guarantee envelope lookups for billing runs. what retention and hot cache plan?

tara: suggestion: hot cache (Redis) 14d, cold S3 90d. index in Dynamo for prov_id->S3 key. billing jobs read cold store if cache miss; realtime aggregations hit cache.

min: metrics tagging? we can't tag every metric with model variant else cardinality explodes.

tara: derive a stable_tag at ingest (tenant+route) and attach detail_tag only to traces. aggregation pipeline can join envelope->detail when needed.

ops-bot: infra note: adding X-Prov-Id header requires ingress-config bump; PR draft in #infra.

gil: action items: tara+min proto for envelope, infra prototype cache; sync Mon.

tara: cheers, will post proto draft and sample headers. :sparkles:
